GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (10 Oct 46) GA
(SCAPIN - 1260)
APO 500
10 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the display of the Japanese national flag on 17 October 1946 as requested by C.L.O. No. 5195 (PK) dated 7 October 1946, subject as above.
2. Occupation troops will be informed in this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
